explication: Files is a Windows file manager. The principal workflow is: a user opens Files, navigates or searches a location, the application resolves and enumerates storage items, then an action performs an operation and the UI presents updated state. Distinct stages include presentation, command dispatch, path/item resolution, provider-specific storage, file operations, and shell integrations. The tree documents multitasking, tags, archives, FTP, previews, Git, dialogs, and Windows integrations; several arrows remain conservative because those callers were not sampled.
